_comment: Pennyroyal Next width policy: pass this file as --speculative-adaptive-config.
Keys are batch-size floors and candidate steps are speculative_num_steps; at topk=1 a
width's draft-token count is steps+1, so C1 is fixed at W8 (steps 7) and every batch of
two or more is fixed at W4 (steps 3). This is concurrency routing, not acceptance-driven
adaptation: one candidate per tier means the width is a lookup on the batch size and the
acceptance EMA can never move it, so no hysteresis or hold/backoff keys are needed or
wider than the launch width is refused, not resized, under captured graphs) and a BS1
bucket in --cuda-graph-bs-decode for the W8 state; without BS1 a C1 batch pads up into
the C>=2 tier and stays W4.
